name: Double Pendulum Chaos
desc: A fan of dozens of double pendulums released from nearly identical angles diverges into chaos, their bob tips tracing luminous curling ribbons that start as one bright bundle then scatter into a spectral spray of sensitive dependence, re-released each section.

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude of the trails

density.doc: number of pendulums in the fan + trail brightness

speed.doc: physics substeps per frame (chaos evolution rate)

scale.doc: arm length / fan size vs design

hue.doc: base hue the spectral fan rotates from

style.doc: render philosophy: index-hue fan / warm fireflies / cyan-magenta neon / white arcs on drafting blue / black ink on cream

seed.doc: deterministic release angle, spread & hue offset
